h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Berhampur

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Berhampur

items.pText: Berhampur, in Ganjam district, is southern Odisha's main commercial town and lies a short drive from the Bay of Bengal coast at Gopalpur. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to schools, colleges, housing projects, hotels and parks in and around Berhampur. Everything is made at our factory in Vasai, about 1,250 km away, sent by road and installed by our team or a dealer in Odisha.

Two things about this coast affect playground equipment. Sea air carries salt inland, which attacks bare steel, and the Odisha coast is exposed to cyclones after the monsoon. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts deal with the salt well, since zinc protects the steel and plastic does not rust. For wind, the answer is a firm installation. On open coastal sites we usually recommend grouting posts into concrete rather than a self-standing base.

richText.heading: Installing playground equipment on a cyclone-prone coast

c: Grouted posts set in a concrete footing hold equipment in place when strong winds arrive. Avoid loose items such as unfixed benches or shade cloth near the play area, as they can blow into the equipment.

items.q: Is grouting better than a self-standing base near the coast?
items.a: On open, windy coastal sites, usually yes. Posts grouted into concrete stay firmly anchored in strong winds. We confirm the method after seeing photos of your ground.

items.q: Does salt air damage playground equipment?
items.a: Salt attacks bare steel, but galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic resist corrosion. Rinsing the equipment with fresh water from time to time washes off salt deposits.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Ganjam district?
items.a: Yes. We send the equipment from our Vasai factory by road and install it in Berhampur and nearby towns with our team or a dealer in Odisha.
